name: Historic Centre of Urbino
description: Perched on a steep hillside in Italy's Marche region, Urbino is a small walled town that looks much as it did in the Renaissance. Under Duke Federico da Montefeltro in the 15th century it drew artists and scholars from across Italy. Its showpiece is the Palazzo Ducale, rebuilt by Luciano Laurana, while the University of Urbino, founded in 1506, still gives the town a youthful energy.
